data.name: Create Undead
data.description: You add Create Undead to your formula book as a 4th-level extract.  When you use this extract, rather than drinking it, you inject it into the corpse you intend to animate, which rises as an uncontrolled undead 1 hour later.  This extract can only create corporeal undead.
